manuscript_title: Beam Deflection at the support span

evidence.quote: Under dry conditions, the probe measured 13 mm at the support span.

rows.target: 干燥条件下，位移探针的读数为 13 mm。

evidence.quote: The reference probe recorded 19 mm at the support span.

rows.target: 参考位移探针在同一地点测得 19 mm。

evidence.quote: Only the dry condition was observed; the beam deflection outside that condition was not measured.

rows.target: 仅观测了干燥条件，其他条件下的梁挠度没有测量。
